payload.name: foodora
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
foodora lets users discover nearby food delivery restaurants, search for vendors and dishes, and browse full menus with prices, ratings, delivery estimates, and active promotions. Each result includes deep links so the user can continue to order in the foodora app or website. Results render in interactive vendor and menu card widgets.

This is only available in Sweden for now; other countries are coming soon.
payload.longDescription:
foodora 帮助用户发现附近的外卖餐厅、搜索商家和菜品，并浏览完整菜单，包括价格、评分、配送时间估算和有效促销。每条结果都包含深层链接，方便用户继续在 foodora 应用或网站上点餐。结果以交互式商家和菜单卡片呈现。

目前仅在瑞典提供服务，其他国家和地区即将开放。

payload.name: Le Parisien
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Accédez aux informations du Parisien : retrouvez les dernières actualités, recherchez des articles et suivez nos directs des grands événements facilement depuis ChatGPT.

Une façon simple et rapide de rester informé de l’actualité avec Le Parisien
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中访问 Le Parisien 新闻：轻松获取最新消息、搜索文章，并关注重大事件的实时报道。

通过 Le Parisien，以简单快捷的方式了解最新资讯。

payload.name: Rentals.ca Rental Search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Canadian rental listings by city or nearby landmark and view matching apartments, homes, prices, photos, and locations in ChatGPT. Users can search by city, apply common filters such as rent, beds, baths, parking, pets, furnished status, lease terms, availability, and verified listings, or search near a landmark, university, building, or station. Results include concise listing summaries for ChatGPT and an interactive widget with listing cards, a map, pagination, and links back to Rentals.ca listing pages.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中按城市或附近地标搜索加拿大租赁房源，并查看匹配公寓、住宅、价格、照片和位置。用户可按城市搜索，应用租金、卧室数、浴室数、停车位、宠物、家具配置、租约条款、可入住时间和已验证房源等常用筛选条件，也可搜索地标、大学、建筑或车站附近的房源。结果包含简明房源摘要，便于 ChatGPT 展示，并提供带房源卡片、地图、分页和 Rentals.ca 房源页面链接的交互式组件。

payload.name: Access Yami
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access Yami helps users shop the largest Asian grocery & lifestyle store in North America directly inside ChatGPT. Users can take a Brand Taste Identity (BTI) quiz to discover their snack persona and get personalized picks, search and browse 10,000+ products by keyword, category, or brand, see trending best-sellers, link their Yami account, add items to their real Yami cart, and get a checkout link to complete purchase on yami.com.
payload.longDescription: Access Yami 帮助用户直接在 ChatGPT 中选购北美最大的亚洲食品和生活用品商店的商品。用户可以参加 Brand Taste Identity（BTI）测试，发现自己的零食偏好类型并获取个性化推荐；按关键词、类别或品牌搜索和浏览 10,000+ 件商品；查看热门畅销品；关联 Yami 账号；将商品添加到真实的 Yami 购物车；获取结账链接，在 yami.com 完成购买。

payload.name: CellFusion C
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CellFusion C helps users find CellFusionC skincare products that match their skin type, concerns, preferred texture, use case, and requested category. It searches the Cafe24 product catalog, ranks suitable products, and displays recommendation cards with product images, prices, purchase links, and concise guidance.
payload.longDescription: CellFusion C 帮助用户根据肤质、肌肤问题、偏好的质地、使用场景和指定类别，查找合适的 CellFusionC 护肤产品。它会搜索 Cafe24 商品目录、为适合的产品排序，并显示包含商品图片、价格、购买链接和简明建议的推荐卡片。

payload.name: LFmall
payload.description: 发现让你成为自己的品味，LFmall AI 购物
payload.summaryOriginal: 나를 나답게 만드는 취향 발견, LFmall AI 쇼핑
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
복잡한 검색 대신 대화로 쇼핑하세요. LFmall은 당신의 스타일과 상황(TPO)을 이해하여 가장 '나다운' 패션과 라이프스타일 아이템을 찾아드립니다.
수만 개의 프리미엄 브랜드 상품 중 당신에게 딱 맞는 상품을 즉시 추천 받고, 공식몰만의 안전한 배송과 단독 혜택까지 한 번에 경험해 보세요. 
단순한 구매를 넘어 당신의 취향을 깊이 있게 완성해 드립니다.
payload.longDescription:
告别复杂搜索，用对话来购物。LFmall 能理解你的风格和场景（TPO），为你找到最符合“自我风格”的时尚与生活用品。
从数万件高端品牌商品中，即时为你推荐最合适的商品，还能一次享受官方商城的安心配送和独家优惠。
不止于购买，更深入地完善你的个人品味。

payload.name: Pararius
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: With Pararius, everyone can easily find the right home. Open the site or app and search the Netherlands' largest private-sector housing offering in just a few seconds. Type a city, neighbourhood or postcode to discover properties, use filters to refine listings by price, surface area, number of rooms or furnishing, set alerts to be the first to know about new homes and contact the agent directly. An intuitive platform to use, even without experience in the Dutch rental market. Search for the home that fits you, from studios and apartments in Amsterdam to family houses in Apeldoorn.
payload.longDescription: 借助 Pararius，每个人都能轻松找到合适的家。打开网站或应用，只需几秒即可搜索荷兰最大的私人住房市场。输入城市、街区或邮政编码发现房源，按价格、面积、房间数量或家具配置筛选，设置提醒以第一时间获知新房，并直接联系中介。即使没有荷兰租赁市场经验，也能直观使用。从阿姆斯特丹的单间和公寓到阿珀尔多伦的家庭住宅，找到适合你的家。

payload.name: DEWA

Explore DEWA services with clear descriptions and apply directly through the App. Stay updated with the latest DEWA news, and access DEWA support channels directly through ChatGPT whenever you need assistance.

The App also helps you find nearby EV Green Charger stations with availability details and locate DEWA Customer Happiness Centers.

Connect to DEWA through ChatGPT for quick, simple, and convenient access to everything you need in one place.

payload.name: CarsGuide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search for cars currently listed for sale across Australia and read expert reviews to help you decide. Browse thousands of new and used car listings by make, model, location, price range, and more — or just describe what you're looking for in plain language. Each result includes price, odometer, photos, and a direct link to the full listing. You can also find editorial reviews with expert ratings to compare models before you buy.
payload.longDescription: 搜索澳大利亚当前在售的汽车，并阅读专家评测，帮助你做出决定。按品牌、车型、地点、价格范围等条件浏览数千条新车和二手车信息，也可以直接用日常语言描述需求。每条结果都包含价格、里程表读数、照片以及完整车辆信息的直接链接。你还可以查看带专家评分的编辑评测，在购车前比较不同车型。

payload.name: UltraFit360
payload.description: 你的 AI 健身教练
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: UltraFit360 connects ChatGPT to your personal fitness and nutrition data. Ask what you ate this week, how your weight is trending, what workouts you logged, or for a full progress report — answers come straight from your UltraFit360 food diary, workout logs, body metrics, and AI coaching memory. With your confirmation, it can also log the meals you eat, adjust your daily calorie, macro, water and step targets, plan meals, swap exercises, and assign or build workout programs. Your identity comes solely from your authenticated session, so the app only ever accesses your own data. UltraFit360 is operated by Aptix Labs Private Limited; see https://ultrafit360.com/privacy-policy for how connector data is handled.
payload.longDescription: UltraFit360 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的个人健身和营养数据。你可以询问本周吃了什么、体重趋势如何、记录了哪些训练，或索取完整进展报告；回答直接来自 UltraFit360 饮食日记、训练记录、身体指标和 AI 教练记忆。经你确认后，它还可以记录你吃过的餐食、调整每日卡路里、宏量营养素、饮水量和步数目标、规划餐食、更换训练动作，以及分配或创建训练计划。你的身份完全依据已验证的登录会话，因此应用只会访问你自己的数据。UltraFit360 由 Aptix Labs Private Limited 运营；有关连接器数据的处理方式，请参阅 https://ultrafit360.com/privacy-policy。

payload.name: GrailPeople Shopping
payload.description: 查找真实可信的产品评价
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search 7,000+ skincare, makeup, and hair products by ingredient, concern, or skin type, and get shopping recommendations. GrailPeople shows what beauty experts actually say, including estheticians, makeup artists, and beauty content creators. Every review comes with quotes, video timestamps, and creator credentials.
payload.longDescription: 按成分、关注问题或肤质搜索 7,000 多种护肤、彩妆和护发产品，并获取购物建议。GrailPeople 展示美容专家的真实观点，包括美容师、化妆师和美容内容创作者。每条评价都附有引述、视频时间戳和创作者资历。

payload.name: Able.Style
payload.description: 适应各种天气的穿搭灵感
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Able.Style is a personal fashion and style assistant that helps you decide what to wear using clothes from your own closet, the occasion, and local weather conditions.

Ask questions like “What should I wear today?”, “What should I wear for a casual work day?” or “What outfit works for cold and rainy weather?” Get complete outfit ideas with specific clothing items and visual fashion inspiration for work, weekends, events, hot weather, cold weather, rain, and changing forecasts.

Weather-aware outfit recommendations use the location saved in your Able.Style account when you’re signed in, or the location you share with ChatGPT. You can also choose your preferred temperature and wind speed units.

When you sign in, you can add clothes you own to your closet and like or dislike outfits to refine future style suggestions. Able.Style personalizes fashion recommendations based on your wardrobe and past preferences.

It’s a simple way to save time, avoid outfit guesswork, develop your personal style, and make better use of the clothes you already have.
payload.longDescription:
Able.Style 是个人时尚与穿搭助手，根据你的衣橱、场合和当地天气情况，帮助你决定穿什么。

可以询问“今天该穿什么？”、“休闲工作日该穿什么？”或“寒冷多雨的天气适合什么搭配？”。获取包含具体单品的完整穿搭建议和视觉时尚灵感，适用于工作、周末、活动、炎热、寒冷、下雨以及变化中的天气预报。

结合天气的穿搭建议会在你登录时使用 Able.Style 账号中保存的位置，或使用你向 ChatGPT 提供的位置。你还可以选择偏好的温度和风速单位。

登录后，你可以将已有衣物添加到衣橱，并对搭配点赞或点踩，优化未来的穿搭建议。Able.Style 根据你的衣橱和以往偏好提供个性化时尚推荐。

这是一种简单的方法，帮你节省时间、避免猜测搭配、发展个人风格，并更充分地利用已有衣物。

payload.name: Standvirtual
payload.description: 在 Standvirtual 寻找理想座驾
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find your dream car in Portugal using everyday language. Skip the complex filters and search forms. With Standvirtual, simply describe what you're looking for - "SUV with low milage great for family of 4 " or "recent model, city car"

1. Smart search - Describe your ideal car in natural language

用日常语言在葡萄牙寻找理想汽车。无需复杂筛选器和搜索表单。使用 Standvirtual，只需描述你想找什么——“适合 4 人家庭的低里程 SUV”或“较新的城市小型车”。

payload.name: Texas Electricity
payload.description: 通过实际用电量对比电力计划
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Texas Electricity, from Meter Energy, compares residential electricity plans in deregulated Texas ZIP codes. Provide a ZIP code and optional monthly usage to see estimated bills, effective rates, contract terms, fees, renewable percentages, and available plan documents and signup links. Filter by exact or minimum contract length, retailer, or 100% renewable content. Usage defaults to 1,000 kWh per month, and searches without a retailer or term filter use 12-month plans. Compact comparisons show a curated selection sorted by estimated rate, may include Meter Energy's Standard plan, and favor selected providers; they are not an exhaustive list of the cheapest plans. If a requested retailer has no matches, results include other providers with an explanatory message. Estimates are not guaranteed bills. Signup takes place on an external website; the app does not enroll customers or access customer accounts. Search inputs and link clicks are recorded for analytics. Unsupported or unverified service areas return an error instead of fallback rates.
payload.longDescription: 由Meter Energy提供的Texas Electricity服务，可比较德克萨斯州非管制地区的邮编电力计划。输入邮编和可选的月用电量，即可查看预估账单、有效费率、合同条款、费用、可再生能源比例以及可用的计划文件和注册链接。按精确或最短合同期限、零售商或100%可再生能源内容进行筛选。默认用电量为每月1000千瓦时，未设置零售商或条款筛选的搜索将使用12个月计划。紧凑比较显示按预估费率排序的精选列表，可能包含Meter Energy的标准计划，并偏向选定的供应商；这些列表并非最便宜计划的完整列表。如果请求的零售商没有匹配结果，搜索结果将包含其他供应商并附有说明信息。预估结果不保证为实际账单。注册需在外部网站进行；该应用不会注册客户或访问客户账户。搜索输入和链接点击将被记录用于分析。不支持或未验证的服务区域将返回错误，而非备用费率。

payload.name: Zinde AI Free Calorie Tracker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Zinde connects ChatGPT with your Zinde account so you can review daily nutrition, water, steps, exercise, and goal progress in one place. Ask for a daily or weekly summary, get meal suggestions based on your remaining targets, update your goals, and log meals, water, or exercise after reviewing a preview.
payload.longDescription: Zinde 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的 Zinde 账户，让你在同一处查看每日营养、饮水、步数、运动和目标进度。可以请求每日或每周摘要，根据剩余目标获取饮食建议，更新目标，并在查看预览后记录饮食、饮水或运动。

payload.name: NannyFYI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search public caregiver profiles, compare qualifications and reviews, verify NannyFYI skills certificates, browse public caregiver job listings, and explore aggregate caregiver market statistics.
payload.longDescription: 搜索公开的护理人员资料，比较资质和评价，验证 NannyFYI 技能证书，浏览公开的护理工作列表，并探索护理人员市场的汇总统计数据。

payload.name: Imóveis Magiko IA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Encontre o imóvel certo descrevendo o que você procura em linguagem natural — bairro, número de quartos, faixa de preço ou estilo de vida. A busca por inteligência artificial entende sua intenção e retorna os imóveis mais relevantes da carteira, com fotos, preço e detalhes. payload.name: Tonita
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tonita is a search engine for apparel and accessories, built to work with how you actually think about shopping. It brings together products from hundreds of stores, thousands of brands, and millions of items — all in one place, from clothing and footwear to cosmetics and everyday essentials.

There isn’t just one way to shop. Sometimes you’re focused on price or practicality; other times it’s about style, fit, materials, or longevity. What matters can shift with the situation — work, travel, special occasions, outdoor use, or everyday wear. Tonita brings these options together, making it easier for you to browse, compare, and make an informed choice.

Within ChatGPT, Tonita works best as part of a conversation. You can explore broad questions, half-formed ideas, or specific constraints naturally — whether that means thinking through what to buy for a particular occasion, learning about materials or categories, or narrowing in on a specific kind of product. ChatGPT helps shape your thoughts into useful searches, and Tonita surfaces a wide set of relevant results for you to browse, compare, and refine as the picture becomes clearer. (For more advanced tools like virtual try-on, saving favorites, and deeper browsing, Tonita can also be used directly at Tonita.co.)

Tonita is built to support the way you actually think about shopping — by priorities, context, and tradeoffs — rather than forcing everything into rigid categories. This includes the ability to search and explore across aspects like:

• Budget and value: From fast fashion and sale finds to higher-end pieces, investment items, and everyday staples.
• Style and aesthetic: Minimalist, maximalist, classic, streetwear, formal, playful, utilitarian, fashion-forward, or timeless — and combinations of these.
• Trends and longevity: What’s popular right now, last season’s styles, and pieces meant to stay relevant beyond a trend cycle.
• Use case and setting: Work, travel, special occasions, outdoor use, events, lounging, or everyday wear.
• Fit, sizing, and comfort: Different body types and needs, including petite and extended sizing, relaxed or tailored fits, and comfort-first designs.
• Materials and feel: Natural fibers, synthetics, performance fabrics, lightweight layers, structured pieces, or materials chosen for warmth, breathability, or softness.
• Durability and care: Easy-care basics, machine-washable items, wrinkle-resistant pieces, or garments meant to be worn, repaired, and kept longer.
• Sustainability priorities: Interest in materials, production methods, longevity, or brands taking different approaches to environmental impact.
• Brand familiarity and discovery: Well-known labels alongside emerging brands, niche designers, and alternatives to the usual options.
• Putting a full look together: Apparel, footwear, accessories, jewelry, and cosmetics, considered side by side rather than in isolation.
payload.longDescription:
Tonita 是一个服装和配饰搜索引擎，旨在配合你实际的购物思路。它汇集数百家商店、数千个品牌和数百万件商品，涵盖服装、鞋履、化妆品和日常必需品。

购物方式不止一种。有时你关注价格或实用性；有时则更在意风格、合身度、材质或耐穿性。不同场景下的重点也会改变——工作、旅行、特殊场合、户外活动或日常穿着。Tonita 将这些选择汇集在一起，让你更容易浏览、比较并做出明智选择。

在 ChatGPT 中，Tonita 最适合以对话方式使用。你可以自然地探索宽泛的问题、尚未成形的想法或具体限制条件，例如思考某个场合该买什么、了解材质或商品类别，或缩小到某类特定产品。ChatGPT 会帮助你把想法整理成有效搜索，Tonita 则提供大量相关结果供你浏览、比较和筛选，让需求逐渐清晰。（如需虚拟试穿、收藏和深入浏览等高级工具，也可直接访问 Tonita.co 使用 Tonita。）

Tonita 根据优先事项、具体情境和取舍来支持真实购物思路，而不是把所有内容塞进固定类别。你可以按以下方面搜索和探索：

• 预算与价值：从快时尚和折扣好物，到高端单品、值得投资的商品和日常基础款。
• 风格与审美：极简、繁复、经典、街头、正式、俏皮、实用、时尚前沿或历久弥新，也可以混搭。
• 潮流与耐久性：当下流行、上一季款式，以及旨在超越潮流周期、长期不过时的单品。
• 用途与场景：工作、旅行、特殊场合、户外使用、活动、休闲或日常穿着。
• 合身度、尺码与舒适度：不同体型和需求，包括 petite 及加大尺码、宽松或修身版型，以及优先考虑舒适度的设计。
• 材质与触感：天然纤维、合成材料、功能面料、轻薄层搭、挺括单品，或为保暖、透气、柔软而选择的材质。
• 耐用性与护理：易打理基础款、可机洗单品、抗皱服饰，或适合长期穿着、修补和保留的衣物。
• 可持续发展优先事项：关注材质、生产方式、耐久性，或在环境影响方面采取不同做法的品牌。
• 熟悉品牌与发现新品牌：知名品牌与新兴品牌、小众设计师品牌，以及常见选择之外的替代品牌。
• 搭配完整造型：将服装、鞋履、配饰、珠宝和化妆品放在一起考虑，而非孤立选择。

payload.name: Guanyin Oracle · 观音灵签
payload.description: 以中文为主的灵签仪式
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Guanyin Oracle offers a quiet, Chinese-first reflection ritual based on a bundled 100-sign Guanyin corpus. Hold one focused question, make one symbolic draw, then confirm it with one symbolic cup action. The source sign poem and traditional note remain in Chinese, with a detailed interpretation in Chinese and faithful English.

Each reading connects the sign to the question, distinguishes reflection from prediction, and offers practical seven-day actions and clear boundaries for health, financial, legal, and other consequential topics. Users may optionally save a JPEG card for the exact sign they drew. The service processes only inputs needed to return the reading and does not persist ritual sessions.
payload.longDescription:
Guanyin Oracle 提供宁静的中文优先反思仪式，基于内置的观音 100 签内容。专注于一个问题，象征性地抽取一签，再以一次象征性的掷杯动作确认。原始签诗和传统注解保留中文，并提供详细的中文解读及忠实的英文译文。

每次解读都会结合问题说明签意，区分反思与预测，并针对健康、财务、法律及其他重大议题提供切实可行的七日行动建议和明确边界。用户还可选择为抽中的确切签号保存 JPEG 签卡。服务仅处理生成解读所需的输入，不会保存仪式会话。

Read a briefing for your saved artist roster, then explore an individual artist’s songs, stations, and trends.

Results link back to xmplaylist reports and explain the selected time period and available coverage. With an explicit request, prepare a CSV export and receive its download link by email. You can also check your latest export’s status from chat.

Requires an xmplaylist account with API access. Requests share your plan’s daily API allowance. Recorded airplay may be incomplete; first detection is not a song’s release date. xmplaylist is not an official SiriusXM product.
payload.longDescription:
探索 xmplaylist 跟踪的 SiriusXM 播放记录。查找歌曲在哪些地方播放、发现新加入电台的歌曲、查看电台播放次数最多的曲目，并比较歌曲和艺人获得的支持变化。查看已保存艺人名单的简报，再深入了解单个艺人的歌曲、电台和趋势。

结果会链接回 xmplaylist 报告，并说明所选时间段和可用覆盖范围。经你明确请求后，可准备 CSV 导出文件，并通过电子邮件发送下载链接。你也可以在聊天中查看最近一次导出的状态。

需要拥有 API 访问权限的 xmplaylist 账号。请求会占用你套餐的每日 API 配额。已记录的播放情况可能不完整；首次检测日期并不代表歌曲发行日期。xmplaylist 不是 SiriusXM 官方产品。

payload.name: Slide15
payload.description: 在聊天中玩 15 数字华容道
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Slide15 is a sliding-tile puzzle you can play without leaving ChatGPT. Ask for a puzzle and a board appears in the conversation: swipe, tap or use the arrow keys to slide the numbered tiles until they read in order. Every puzzle is shuffled with legal moves, so it can always be solved. New boards on demand, a timer and move counter, a short how-to-play primer for first-time players, and full localisation in English, Russian and Spanish. No account is needed and nothing is collected beyond anonymous usage analytics. The same game is free on the web at slide15.com and on iPhone and iPad.
payload.longDescription: Slide15 是一款无需离开 ChatGPT 即可游玩的滑块拼图。只需请求一个谜题，棋盘就会出现在对话中：滑动、轻点或使用方向键移动数字方块，直到数字按顺序排列。每个谜题都通过合法移动打乱，因此总能解出。可随时生成新棋盘，还提供计时器、步数计数器、供新手查看的简短玩法说明，以及完整的英语、俄语和西班牙语本地化。无需账户，除匿名使用分析外不会收集其他数据。同一款游戏也可在 slide15.com、iPhone 和 iPad 上免费游玩。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Triad Astro reads your birth chart in three astrological traditions at once - Western (Tropical), Vedic (Sidereal), and Chinese (BaZi / Four Pillars) - and shows you where they agree.

Give it a birth date, plus a time and place if you know them, and it calculates all three charts in a single step: Sun, Moon and rising signs, planetary aspects and elemental balance from the Western system; Nakshatra, Navamsa, planetary dignity and the Vimshottari Dasha timeline from the Vedic system; and the Four Pillars, Day Master and ten-year Luck Pillars from the Chinese system.

Most astrology tools give you one system's answer. Triad Astro gives you three, then helps you read the overlap - the themes that show up independently in all three are the ones worth a closer look.

Planetary positions are computed from ephemeris data aligned to NASA JPL standards, and birth places are resolved to coordinates with automatic timezone handling, so charts are accurate to the minute when the birth time is known. Ambiguous place names can be looked up first so you can confirm the right city.

No account or sign-in is required. Just ask for a reading - for example: "Calculate my tri-system birth chart. I was born March 14, 1990 at 7:45am in Bangalore, India."
payload.longDescription:
Triad Astro 同时依据 3 种占星传统解读你的出生星盘——西方占星（回归黄道）、吠陀占星（恒星黄道）和中国命理（八字/四柱）——并展示它们的共通之处。

提供出生日期；如果知道，也提供出生时间和地点。它会一次性计算这 3 张星盘：西方体系的太阳、月亮和上升星座、行星相位及元素平衡；吠陀体系的纳克沙特拉、Navamsa、行星尊贵状态及 Vimshottari Dasha 时间线；以及中国体系的四柱、日主和十年大运。

大多数占星工具只给出一种体系的解读。Triad Astro 会提供 3 种解读，并帮助你查看其重叠之处——那些在 3 种体系中各自独立出现的主题，值得进一步关注。

行星位置依据符合 NASA JPL 标准的星历数据计算；出生地点会解析为坐标并自动处理时区，因此在已知出生时间时，星盘时间可精确到分钟。遇到含义不明确的地名时，可先查询并确认正确城市。

无需账户或登录。只需请求解读，例如：“计算我的三体系出生星盘。我出生于 1990 年 March 14 日上午 7:45，地点是 India 的 Bangalore。”

payload.name: TNT Sweeper
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TNT Sapper is a compact deduction puzzle played inside ChatGPT. Reveal safe tiles on an 8-by-8 field, use numbers to identify adjacent explosives, and flag suspected TNT. Clear all 54 safe tiles while avoiding 10 explosives to win. The first reveal and its surrounding tiles are protected. Play with touch, mouse, or keyboard, and start another field using New game in the component. Unfinished runs expire after 60 minutes. No separate player account, payment, or advertising is required.
payload.longDescription:
TNT Sapper 是一款在 ChatGPT 内部运行的紧凑推理谜题。
在8x8网格中揭示安全方块，通过数字识别相邻爆炸物，并标记疑似TNT。
在避开10个爆炸物的同时清除全部54个安全方块即可获胜。
首次揭示的方块及其周围方块处于保护状态。
可通过触控、鼠标或键盘操作，通过组件内的「新游戏」启动新场地。
未完成的游戏将在60分钟后过期。
无需独立玩家账户、支付或广告。

payload.name: Ziweave
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
You don't need to know how to read a birth chart to explore what it might mean for you. Ziweave introduces Zi Wei Dou Shu, a traditional Chinese astrology system, through readings based on your personal chart. Once you've finished setting up your birth details, Ziweave generates your chart and provides it to the AI, which uses the chart as the basis for its readings.

Ask about work, relationships or the themes of a month or year in your own words. Follow up with “Why?” or share what's happening in your life to explore how the reading relates to your situation. You bring the questions; the conversation helps make the chart easier to understand.

Try asking: “What does my chart suggest about my strengths at work, and how might I put them to use?”
payload.longDescription:
即使不了解如何阅读命盘，你也可以探索命盘可能代表的含义。Ziweave 通过基于个人命盘的解读，带你了解中国传统占星体系紫微斗数。完成出生信息设置后，Ziweave 会生成命盘并提供给 AI，AI 将以此为依据进行解读。

用自己的话询问工作、人际关系，或某个月、某一年的主题。你可以追问“为什么？”，也可以分享生活近况，进一步探索解读与你自身情况的关联。由你提出问题，通过对话让命盘更容易理解。

试着询问：“我的命盘显示我在工作中的优势是什么？我可以如何发挥这些优势？”

payload.name: VerseDB: Comic Book Tracker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: VerseDB helps existing VerseDB Pro members search comics, inspect issues and market prices, review their collections and reading progress, and track upcoming releases. Users can also add or update owned copies, follow series, manage curated lists, and publish reviews or ratings. Collection copies and lists may be publicly visible; confirm the intended target and visibility before making changes.
payload.longDescription: VerseDB帮助现有VerseDB Pro会员搜索漫画、查看具体问题和市场价格、回顾收藏情况与阅读进度，并跟踪即将发布的作品。用户还可添加或更新所持副本、关注系列作品、管理精选清单并发布评论或评分。收藏的副本和清单可能对公众可见，请在修改前确认目标对象和可见范围。

payload.name: Storieta
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask to see a classic and Storieta shows it: comic pages you can turn, scenes painted from the opening chapters, and portraits of the people in the story.

It covers public-domain novels and plays such as Frankenstein, Dracula, Pride and Prejudice, Wuthering Heights, and Romeo and Juliet. Each comic opens with its first pages here, and every result links to the book on storieta.com.

Storieta shows art it has already published. It doesn't draw on request, and it doesn't carry modern or copyrighted books.
payload.longDescription:
只需提出想阅读的经典作品，Storieta便会呈现：可翻页的漫画、根据开篇章节绘制的场景，以及故事中人物的肖像。

涵盖《弗兰肯斯坦》、《德古拉》、《傲慢与偏见》、《呼啸山庄》和《罗密欧与朱丽叶》等公共领域的小说和戏剧。每部漫画均从其前几页开始呈现，所有结果均链接至storieta.com上的原著书籍。

Storieta仅展示已出版的艺术作品，不接受定制创作，也不包含现代作品或受版权保护的书籍。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Page through comic adaptations of classic novels, See illustrated scenes from a book's opening, Meet a book's characters through portraits, Find illustrated editions by title, author, or theme

payload.name: 映画館ガイド | Eigakan Guide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find cinema showtimes across Japan without checking each cinema's website separately. Search by movie, area, cinema, date, start time, finish time, and screening features such as IMAX, Dolby Cinema, English audio, and English subtitles.

Eigakan Guide supports Japanese and English. Results include movie posters, cinemas, screening times in Japan Standard Time, and links to the matching listings on Eigakan Guide. Use Show more to load additional screenings with the same conditions.

An Eigakan Guide account is not required. The plugin searches collected schedules, not live seat availability, and cannot reserve seats or purchase tickets. Schedules can change; confirm the details on the cinema's official website before booking. Coverage is limited to supported cinemas and published schedules. English audio is marked only for eligible subtitled screenings of movies whose original English audio has been confirmed. English subtitles are a separate screening feature.
payload.longDescription:
无需逐一查看各家影院网站即可查询日本全国的电影院排片信息。可通过电影名称、地区、影院、日期、开始时间、结束时间以及IMAX、杜比影院、英语音轨、英语字幕等放映特色进行搜索。

Eigakan Guide支持日文和英文显示。搜索结果包含电影海报、影院信息、日本标准时间的放映时间，以及对应Eigakan Guide页面的链接。点击「显示更多」可加载相同条件下的更多排片信息。

无需Eigakan Guide账户即可使用。插件搜索的是已收录的排期信息，而非实时座位可售情况，无法预订座位或购买票务。排期信息可能随时变更，请在预订前务必通过影院官网确认详细信息。服务仅覆盖支持的影院及已发布的排期内容。英语音轨仅标注于确认原声为英语的字幕影片，英语字幕为独立放映特色。

payload.name: Trovr
payload.description: 纽约市演出及音乐试听
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Trovr helps music fans discover live entertainment in the New York metro area. Find concerts, jazz shows and DJ nights by date, genre, neighborhood, venue, budget or mood. Listen to artist music previews, explore artist details, and compare event cards with venue information, dates and links to third-party ticket sellers. Coverage includes New York City, Long Island, Westchester, northern New Jersey and southwest Connecticut. Trovr does not sell tickets or process purchases.
payload.longDescription:
Trovr帮助音乐爱好者发现纽约都会区的现场娱乐活动。
可通过日期、流派、社区、场馆、预算或心情搜索音乐会、爵士演出和DJ之夜。
聆听艺术家音乐试听，探索艺术家详情，并对比包含场馆信息、日期和第三方票务卖家链接的活动卡片。
覆盖区域包括纽约市、长岛、韦斯特切斯特、北新泽西和西南康涅狄格。
Trovr不销售门票或处理购买事宜。

payload.name: CardShow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use your own CardShow saves, follows, alerts, private show plans, attendance, and optional connected HobbyWise Hunt List to decide which card shows fit your goals and arrive prepared. Find public shows and shops, compare seller-declared show coverage, review your personal activity, and make exact CardShow updates only after you confirm them. Seller declarations are planning leads, not inventory or availability guarantees.
payload.longDescription:
利用您自己的CardShow保存、关注、警报、私人展会计划、参与情况，以及可选的HobbyWise猎物清单，决定哪些展会符合您的目标，并做好充分准备。
查找公共展会和店铺，比较卖家声明的展会覆盖范围，查看您的个人活动记录，并在确认后仅对CardShow进行精确更新。
卖家声明仅作为规划参考，不构成库存或可用性的保证。

payload.name: WhatsTheID
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
WhatsTheID connects your assistant to its database of DJ set tracklists from YouTube. Ask what was played in a set, which track is playing at a given moment of a video, which sets a track has been played in, or what a channel has uploaded recently. Answers come from WhatsTheID's public tracklists, with links to the full tracklist and to the exact moment on YouTube.

Every track is labelled so you know how far to trust it: identified or still an unknown ID, and whether it comes from the uploader's own tracklist or YouTube's music detection, from listener comments, or from WhatsTheID's audio recognition. Estimated times are marked as estimates. If a set is not on WhatsTheID yet, the assistant says so and gives a link to add it; it never guesses a tracklist.

Tools:
- Search DJ sets: find sets by DJ, event, festival, club, channel or genre.
- Get set tracklist: the full tracklist of one set from its YouTube link.
- Find track at timestamp: the track playing at a moment like 42:10, with the previous and next tracks.
- Search tracks: find a track and the sets it was played in.
- Latest sets from a channel: a channel's newest sets with tracklists.

Read-only, with no account needed. Each answer is small (one tracklist or up to ten results) and links back to whatstheid.com.
payload.longDescription:
WhatsTheID将您的助手连接至其收录的YouTube DJ混音曲目数据库。您可以询问某个混音集中播放了哪些曲目，视频特定时刻正在播放的曲目，某首曲目曾出现在哪些混音集中，或某频道最近上传了哪些内容。答案来自WhatsTheID的公开曲目列表，并附有完整曲目列表链接以及YouTube上的具体时间点链接。

每首曲目都会标注可信度信息：显示为已识别或未知ID，以及该曲目是来自上传者自有的曲目列表、YouTube音乐识别、听众评论，还是WhatsTheID的音频识别结果。预估时间会标注为预估时间。如果某个混音集尚未收录在WhatsTheID中，助手会明确说明并提供添加链接；绝不会猜测曲目列表。

工具：
- 搜索DJ混音集：通过DJ、活动、音乐节、俱乐部、频道或音乐类型查找混音集。
- 获取混音集曲目列表：通过YouTube链接获取某个混音集的完整曲目列表。
- 通过时间戳查找曲目：查找如42:10这样的特定时刻正在播放的曲目，包含前后曲目信息。
- 搜索曲目：查找某首曲目及其出现的混音集。
- 查看频道最新混音集：展示某频道最新上传的混音集及其曲目列表。

纯只读模式，无需账户即可使用。每个回答仅包含单个曲目列表或最多十个结果，并附有返回至whatstheid.com的链接。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search DJ sets by DJ, event, channel or genre, Get the full tracklist of a YouTube DJ set, Find the track playing at any moment of a set, Find the sets a track was played in, List a channel's newest sets with tracklists

payload.name: Angell Naruto RPG Akatsuki
payload.summaryOriginal: Crie técnicas e itens no RPG
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Angell ajuda jogadores do Naruto RPG Akatsuki a criar e revisar técnicas, itens e outras propostas. Consulta as regras oficiais, aponta requisitos e limites, organiza a criação em texto pronto para avaliação e identifica o que ainda depende da staff.
payload.longDescription: Angell帮助《火影忍者RPG晓》玩家创建和审查技能、物品及其他提案。查阅官方规则，指出要求和限制，将创建内容整理成可评估文本，并识别仍需工作人员处理的部分。

payload.name: WeekendSeek
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WeekendSeek weekend exhibition guide (weekendseek.com). Search current and upcoming museum/gallery special exhibitions across 91 cities (Japan, China, Europe, US…), filter by city/region, venue, or keyword, and get detail pages with dates, venue info and links. Data trilingual (中文/English/日本語) — tell it which language you want.
payload.longDescription: WeekendSeek周末展览指南（weekendseek.com）。在91个城市（日本、中国、欧洲、美国等）的博物馆/画廊中搜索当前及即将举办的特别展览，按城市/地区、场馆或关键词筛选，并查看包含日期、场馆信息及链接的详情页。数据支持三种语言（中文/英文/日文）——选择所需语言。

payload.name: CarGene
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CarGene answers questions about the history of Japanese cars from a curated database: which generations of a model were sold and when, their chassis codes, the engineers who developed them, how generations relate (successor, sibling, derivative), and sales figures by country and year. Each fact comes with the source it was taken from. Read-only, no account needed.
payload.longDescription: CarGene通过一个精心整理的数据库回答关于日本汽车历史的问题：某款车型经历了哪些代际、何时上市、车架代码是什么、开发它们的工程师是谁、各代际之间有何关联（如后续代际、同级车型或衍生车型），以及按国家和年份统计的销售数据。每个事实都标明了来源。只读模式，无需账户。

payload.name: KiedyKoncert
payload.description: KiedyKoncert.pl 是波兰的演唱会日历
payload.longDescription:
KiedyKoncert.pl 是波兰的演唱会日历。该插件允许您询问助手，某位选定的艺人何时演出，某个城市或周边地区在特定日期有哪些演唱会，以及具体演唱会的详细信息。

功能包括：
- 根据艺人或活动名称（支持拼写修正）、城市及10-100公里半径范围、日期或快捷方式（"今天"、"本周末"、"下个月"）以及音乐类型搜索即将举行的演唱会；
- 展示艺人巡演的所有已公布日期及取消场次；
- 显示演唱会详细信息：艺人名称、日期、入场和开场时间（如有）、场地和地址、状态（包括售罄、取消、延期）、票价起始价及票务供应商名称；
- 列出各音乐类型对应的即将举行演唱会数量。

数据来源为俱乐部、场馆和文化中心的官方日历以及票务供应商。每个演唱会都会注明来源和最后确认日期。

插件不支持以下功能：
- 仅支持只读模式：不购买门票、不创建账户、不修改数据也不保存提醒；
- 不提供票务链接——每个演唱会均跳转至 KiedyKoncert.pl 的专属页面，该页面显示当前票务供应商；
- 仅涵盖波兰境内的演唱会，且日期从当天开始；
- 若日历中无演唱会会直接提示（"暂无即将举行的演唱会"），不会进行推测。

数据更新频率取决于来源方——出行前建议再次向主办方确认最新状态。

payload.name: Inkspired
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Inkspired is a platform where authors write and publish serialized stories and build the universes behind them. This connector gives your AI assistant access to your own Inkspired author workspace, so it can help you write, revise and understand your work without copy-pasting.


What it can do:



Browse your work: list your stories and open any chapter, including drafts.

Draft and revise: create new stories and chapter drafts, and save changes to drafts.

Proofread safely: suggest corrections that you review and apply. Every change an assistant makes to a chapter is backed up first, so you can restore the previous version.

Build your world: create universes, link stories to them, and add, update or link glossary entries for characters, places and lore.

Understand your readers: read the comments and reviews on your chapters, see your writing stats, and view story performance. Performance includes reads, likes, retention and drop-off, demographics and rankings, within the limits of your plan.

Stay on top of activity: check your recent notifications.


What it can't do: it can never publish, schedule or delete anything. Those actions stay with you on Inkspired. It only has access to your own account, you approve its permissions when you connect, and you can disconnect it at any time.
payload.longDescription:
Inkspired是一个作者撰写和发布连载故事并构建其世界观的平台。该连接器可让您的人工智能助手访问您的Inkspired作者工作区，从而帮助您撰写、修改和理解作品，而无需复制粘贴。

它能做什么：

浏览您的作品：列出您的故事并打开任何章节，包括草稿。

撰写与修改：创建新故事和章节草稿，并保存草稿修改。

安全校对：提出需要您审阅并应用的修改建议。助手对章节的每次修改都会先进行备份，您可以恢复到之前的版本。

构建您的世界：创建世界观，将故事与之关联，并添加、更新或链接角色、地点和背景设定的术语表条目。

了解您的读者：查看章节的评论和评分，查阅写作数据并观察故事表现。表现数据包括阅读量、点赞数、留存率和流失率、受众统计数据和排名，具体取决于您的计划限制。

掌握活动动态：查看最近的通知。

它无法执行发布、排期或删除操作，这些操作仍由您在Inkspired上处理。它仅访问您的个人账户，连接时您需批准其权限，且可随时断开连接。

payload.name: Reading Your Love
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Reading Your Love (RYL) reads the relationship between two people as two gauges: temperature — your drive for romance — and humidity — the depth of feeling for the other person. Give both birth dates and birth cities (birth times sharpen it) and RYL shows an interactive card with where each of you sits on each gauge, named in RYL's own words (Lukewarm / Moderate / Hot, Dry / Moist / Damp). The card is a preview: the exact reading, with the full story behind it, is one tap away on readingyourlove.com, with your details already filled in.
payload.longDescription:
Reading Your Love（RYL）通过两个仪表盘展现两个人的关系：温度——你对浪漫的渴望程度，以及湿度——你对对方情感的深度。
提供双方的出生日期和出生城市（精确的出生时间能提升准确性），RYL会生成一张互动卡片，显示你们在每个仪表盘上的位置，卡片会用RYL特有的词汇进行命名（温热/适中/火热，干燥/湿润/潮湿）。
这张卡片仅作为预览：完整的解读及其中的详细故事，只需轻点一下即可在readingyourlove.com上查看，您的信息已预先填写完毕。

payload.name: MusicAtlas
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MusicAtlas is the fastest way to discover music through sound across major streaming services. Find songs that sound like a track you love, explore similar artists, understand what makes a song sound the way it does, and discover playlists for any mood, genre, activity, or vibe. Listen to playable previews and jump to your favorite music service to hear more.
payload.longDescription:
MusicAtlas 是通过声音跨主流流媒体服务快速发现音乐的最快方式。
找到与您喜爱的歌曲风格相似的歌曲，探索相似艺术家，理解一首歌曲为何具有特定风格，并发现适合任何情绪、流派、活动或氛围的播放列表。
聆听可播放的试听片段，并跳转至您喜爱的音乐服务以了解更多。

payload.name: Form Guide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Football fixtures, results, form and league tables for the Premier League, Championship, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A and Ligue 1, current season (worked out from the date; 2026/27 now). Tables include official points deductions. Understands everyday club names (Spurs, Man Utd, Barca, PSG, Wolves, Nottm Forest, the Toon, Inter Milan), full spoken names and small typos (Liverpol, Nottingham Forrest). Clubs from other leagues that people often ask about (Celtic, Rangers, Ajax, Benfica, Inter Miami) get a 404 that says which league they play in. Every tool is read-only: no sign-in and nothing about the user is stored. There are no ads or paid placements. Built by Good Turn Studio. More at https://formguide.pages.dev

payload.name: Genie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Think of anything without telling me. Genie asks adaptive yes-or-no questions and tries to figure out what you're thinking of.

payload.name: webook.com

It is the one-stop platform to discover and book concerts, sporting events, cultural shows, flights, hotels, restaurants, memorabilia, auctions, and more. Whether you are in Riyadh, Jeddah, the Eastern Province, or anywhere else in the Kingdom, webook.com connects you to everything exciting. webook.com 是沙特阿拉伯的终极超级应用，涵盖娱乐、旅行和生活方式领域。

拥有更新的列表、经过验证的预订和简洁的界面，享受乐趣和规划旅行从未如此简单。

payload.name: Mzelo Watch Party
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mzelo Watch Party sets up a private room on mzelo.com where friends can watch a YouTube video together, in sync, and chat while they watch.

Ask ChatGPT to watch something with friends and either share a YouTube link or say what you'd like to watch. Mzelo creates a room with that video ready to play and gives you a link. Share the link: anyone who has it can join from a browser, with no account or install needed. The first person to open the room gets the remote, so they can play and pause for everyone.

Who it's for: friends, couples, families and groups who live apart and want to watch the same video at the same time.

Limitations: works with public and unlisted YouTube videos that allow embedding; private, removed, age-restricted and embed-blocked videos can't be used. Each request creates one new room; asking again for the same video within a few minutes gives you the same room. When you describe a topic instead of giving a link, Mzelo picks one safe-search YouTube result. Rooms are created on mzelo.com, so watching happens there, not inside ChatGPT. To prevent abuse, the number of rooms one person can create per hour and per day is limited.
payload.longDescription:
Mzelo Watch Party在mzelo.com上创建一个私人房间，朋友可以在此同步观看YouTube视频并边看边聊天。

让ChatGPT邀请朋友一起观看某个内容，可分享YouTube链接或说明想观看的内容。
Mzelo会创建包含该视频的房间并生成链接。
分享链接：拥有链接的人可通过浏览器加入，无需账户或安装。
第一个打开房间的人将获得遥控器权限，可为所有人播放和暂停视频。

适用对象：分隔两地的朋友、情侣、家庭和群体用户，希望同步观看同一视频。

限制条件：仅支持允许嵌入的公开和未列出YouTube视频；私密、已移除、年龄限制和嵌入受限视频无法使用。
每次请求生成一个新房间；同一视频在数分钟内重复请求将获得相同房间。
当描述主题而非提供链接时，Mzelo会选取一个安全搜索的YouTube结果。
房间在mzelo.com创建，因此观看需在该网站进行，而非在ChatGPT内。
为防止滥用，每小时和每天创建房间的数量有限制。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create a private watch party room for a YouTube link, Find a YouTube video for a topic and create a room for it, Return a shareable room link anyone can join without an account

payload.name: Show & Tell
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Show & Tell is a daily photo game you play with ChatGPT. Everyone gets the same secret word each day, and only you can see it: it stays behind a Hold to reveal button, so ChatGPT never sees it. Show it with photos of the real world: your mug, your dog, the light through your window. After each photo, ChatGPT makes one guess and hears how close it is: cold, warm, hot, burning, or correct. Solve it in as few shots as you can.

- Six shots a day. Photos with letters, numbers, or screens are fouls and don't count.
- Stuck? Spend a hint: the category, the length, or the first letter.
- Keep a daily streak and share your score grid without spoiling the word.

A new word unlocks at midnight where you are. No sign-up needed.
payload.longDescription:
Show & Tell 是一个你与 ChatGPT 一起每天游玩的照片游戏。
每天所有人都会获得相同的秘密单词，只有你能看到它：它被隐藏在「按住以显示」按钮后，因此 ChatGPT 永远看不到。
用现实世界的照片展示它：你的杯子、你的狗、你窗前的光线。
每张照片后，ChatGPT 会做出一次猜测，并听到它有多接近：冰冷、温暖、火热、燃烧或正确。
用尽可能少的尝试次数解开谜题。

- 每天六次机会。
包含字母、数字或屏幕的照片视为犯规，不计入次数。
- 卡住了？
消耗一个提示：获取类别、长度或首字母信息。
- 保持每日连续打卡，并分享你的得分表格而不泄露答案。

你所在时区的午夜会解锁新单词。
无需注册即可使用。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Start today's round, Guess the secret word from your photos, Call fouls for photos with letters, numbers, or screens, Give hints when you ask for one, Track your daily streak

Ask for a chart, the 10-year luck pillars (daeun), which zodiac animal a January or February birth really belongs to, or a reference for any of the sixty day-pillar characters. Tools return calculated facts only and take nothing but the birth details you give them. Nothing here predicts events; treat it as reference and entertainment. Supported birth years: 1900 to 2050.

ioreum以专业方式计算韩式四柱（四柱，八字）命理图：节气边界通过天文学精确到分钟计算，出生地真太阳时，以及夜间时辰惯例。

工具仅返回计算结果，仅需提供出生信息即可。
此处内容不预测具体事件；请作为参考和娱乐用途。
支持出生年份：1900年至2050年。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Calculate a saju / BaZi chart, List 10-year luck pillars, Check the zodiac-year boundary, Explain day-pillar characters

payload.name: ChessEver
payload.description: 实时关注国际象棋赛事
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Follow live chess with ChessEver. Find tournaments around the world, see what’s live, and catch up on recorded results.

Ask about an event, explore its rounds and game moves, then open the exact game on ChessEver to watch or replay.

Built for players, coaches, clubs, and fans who want a clean, simple way to stay close to the games that matter. Follow chess better.

通过ChessEver关注实时国际象棋赛事。
查找全球赛事，查看实时进行中的比赛，并回顾已录制的比赛结果。

了解赛事详情，查看赛事轮次和对局进展，然后在ChessEver打开具体对局观看或回放。

专为棋手、教练、俱乐部和粉丝打造，提供简洁清晰的方式，紧贴重要赛事。
更高效地关注国际象棋。

直播数据可能存在延迟或不完整。

payload.name: Coronet Arcade
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Play today's thirteen Coronet Arcade logic and word puzzles in an interactive hub. Open a daily board, use its normal controls and finite hints, or ask for the rules without spoilers. The daily boards match Coronet Arcade. Progress stays in the active widget; some unfinished boards reset when you switch games. This integration has no signup, account synchronization, archive, unlimited practice or purchase flow. An optional website link offers more ways to play.
payload.longDescription:
在互动中心体验今日的13道Coronet Arcade逻辑谜题和文字谜题。
打开每日棋盘，使用常规操作和有限提示，或询问规则且不剧透。
每日棋盘与Coronet Arcade一致。
进度保存在活动组件中；部分未完成棋盘在切换游戏时会重置。
此集成不提供注册、账户同步、存档、无限练习或购买流程。
可选的网站链接提供更多游玩方式。

payload.name: Wix Events Discovery
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Wix Events Discovery finds upcoming in-person events hosted on Wix sites: local concerts, workshops, classes, meetups, festivals and more, mostly in the US, UK, Europe, Canada and Australia. Search by place, dates, genre or activity tags, keywords, category and price, then open an event for its description, venue, prices and the other dates of a recurring series.

Every result links to the organizer's own event page, where tickets are sold; Wix Events Discovery doesn't book or buy tickets. Prices may exclude fees and taxes, so the organizer's page has the final price. Events for adults only (18+) aren't listed, and online-only events can't be found reliably.
payload.longDescription:
Wix Events Discovery可查找在Wix网站上举办的即将举行的线下活动，包括本地音乐会、研讨会、课程、聚会、节日等，主要覆盖美国、英国、欧洲、加拿大和澳大利亚地区。通过地点、日期、类型或活动标签、关键词、类别和价格进行搜索，点击活动查看其描述、场地、价格以及定期系列活动的其他日期。

每个搜索结果均链接至活动组织者的独立页面，门票在此页面销售；Wix Events Discovery不提供票务预订或购买服务。价格可能不包含费用和税款，因此组织者页面显示的最终价格为准。仅限成人（18岁以上）的活动不会列出，纯线上活动无法可靠检索。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search upcoming events, Get event details

payload.name: CollegeSeats
payload.description: 大学体育赛事转售门票
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CollegeSeats is a ticket resale marketplace built only for college sports, starting with SEC football. Ask about a team, a matchup, a stadium or a weekend, and CollegeSeats shows the upcoming games and the tickets for sale: section, row, how many seats sit together, the price per ticket with fees included, and the total for your order.

Every listing has a Buy button that opens collegeseats.com with those seats already selected. Checkout happens on our site; nothing is bought or reserved from inside ChatGPT, and no sign-in is needed to search.

CollegeSeats is a secondary-market resale site, not the official or primary seller. Prices are set by sellers and may be above or below face value. Sales tax is added at checkout. Your payment is held until your tickets arrive. If they never do, you get every cent back.
payload.longDescription:
CollegeSeats是一个仅限大学体育赛事的票务转售市场，最初专注于SEC足球赛事。询问一支球队、一场对阵、一座体育场或一个周末，CollegeSeats将展示即将进行的比赛以及可售门票信息，包括座位区域、排数、连座数量、每张票价格（含费用）以及订单总价。

每个商品列表都配有「购买」按钮，点击后将跳转至collegeseats.com并自动选中对应座位。结账操作在我们的网站完成；通过ChatGPT内部不会进行任何购买或预留操作，搜索时也无需登录。

CollegeSeats是二级市场转售网站，并非官方或原始销售方。价格由卖家设定，可能高于或低于票面价值。结账时会增加销售税。您的付款将被暂存，直至门票送达。若门票未能送达，您将获得全额退款。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find upcoming college games by team, matchup, stadium or date, List resale tickets with prices per ticket, fees included, Link to checkout on collegeseats.com with the seats selected

payload.name: ZoneFoundry for Sonos
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Control the Sonos speakers in your home by talking to ChatGPT. Play songs, artists, albums and playlists, set the volume, group rooms together, move the music to another room, switch to TV, and have a speaker read out a short announcement or a timed reminder. It works in English and Chinese and goes through the official Sonos cloud, so there is nothing to install on your network and it works when you are away from home. You need the free ZoneFoundry iOS app, signed in to your own Sonos account; when you connect, you approve access in the app with a 6-digit code, and you can disconnect ChatGPT from the app at any time.

payload.name: TVBrain: Search Series Guides
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover TV shows without leaving the chat. This app lets you search, browse, and explore thousands of TV series in a simple, interactive view right inside your conversation. Whether you already know the name of a show or just want ideas for what to watch next, you can quickly find useful information without opening another website or app.

Search for a TV show, then see the details in an easy-to-read display. Learn what the show is about, when it first aired, how many seasons it has, who stars in it, and much more. Browse episode lists, explore cast members, and jump between related shows in a natural way. Everything appears inside the chat, making it easy to ask follow-up questions and keep exploring.

You can use the app to:

* Search for TV shows by title.
* Read simple plot summaries.
* View seasons and episodes.
* Explore cast and crew.
* Find genres and release dates.
* See ratings and other key facts.
* Discover similar shows.
* Browse popular and classic series.
* Learn about new and old favorites.

The app is made for everyone. If you only remember part of a show’s name, you can still search for it. If you have never heard of a series before, you can explore and learn about it. If you are trying to decide what to watch tonight, you can compare different shows without leaving the conversation.

Everything is designed to be clear and easy to understand. Information is organized into simple sections so you can quickly find what you need. Instead of reading long pages full of extra details, you can focus on the facts that matter most.

This app also works well when chatting. After opening a show, you can ask questions about it, compare it with another series, learn about the characters, or ask for recommendations based on what you enjoy. The interactive display helps you explore while the conversation continues naturally.

Whether you enjoy comedy, drama, science fiction, fantasy, action, mystery, crime, animation, documentaries, family shows, or reality TV, the app makes it easy to browse across many genres. You can move from one show to another with just a few clicks and discover something new every time.

It is useful for casual viewers, dedicated fans, families looking for something to watch together, and anyone who enjoys learning about television. It is also helpful when someone recommends a show and you want a quick overview before deciding if it is right for you.

Because everything is shown in the chat, you spend less time switching between apps and more time exploring. The interactive layout makes information easier to browse than plain text alone, helping you see important details at a glance.

If you love television, enjoy discovering new series, or simply want a faster way to look up information, this app gives you an easy place to start. Search, explore, compare, and learn about TV shows from around the world, all without leaving your conversation. It is a simple, friendly way to discover your next favorite series and learn more about the shows you already love.

它对普通观众、忠实粉丝、寻找共同观看内容的家庭，以及热爱了解电视节目的人群都非常有用。当有人推荐节目时，您也可以快速获取概览，再决定是否适合您。

payload.name: Miney
payload.summaryOriginal: Clear a board. Climb a level.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Play a compact Minesweeper puzzle directly in the conversation—no sign-in needed. Reveal safe squares, flag suspected mines, and clear the board to reach the next level. Your first reveal and its neighbours are always safe.

payload.name: Should I Fish?
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Should I Fish answers one question: should you fish a spot today or tomorrow? Ask about a town on the Virginia-to-Florida coast and it returns a Go, Maybe, or Skip verdict with its score, the best bite window for the day and why, high and low tide times from the nearest NOAA tide station, wind, moon phase, sunrise, and any active National Weather Service marine alert, called out first when one is in effect. It's built for recreational inshore and surf anglers, and for anyone at a coastal town wondering whether the morning is worth getting up for, across 136 towns on the Atlantic and Gulf coasts from Virginia through Florida. The plugin answers for today and tomorrow only. It does not forecast further ahead, identify species, say what's biting, or cover water outside Virginia-to-Florida. Tide predictions come from NOAA tide stations and marine alerts from the National Weather Service. The verdict is a model built from tide movement, solunar timing, barometric pressure trend, light, and wind: a guide for planning, not a guarantee of a catch, and not for navigation.
payload.longDescription:
Should I Fish？解答一个疑问：今天或明天是否应该在某个地点钓鱼？
查询弗吉尼亚州至佛罗里达州海岸线上的城镇，会返回Go（适合）、Maybe（可考虑）或Skip（不建议）的判断结果，包含当日最佳钓鱼时段及原因、最近NOAA潮汐站的高低潮时间、风速、月相、日出时间，以及任何生效中的国家气象局海洋警报（若有则优先显示）。
该插件专为休闲近海及冲浪垂钓者设计，也适合所有位于大西洋和墨西哥湾沿岸136个城镇的居民，判断清晨是否值得起床钓鱼。
插件仅提供今天和明天的信息。
它不进行更远期的预测，不识别鱼种、不说明哪种鱼正咬钩，也不覆盖弗吉尼亚州至佛罗里达州以外的水域。
潮汐预测数据来自NOAA潮汐站，海洋警报信息来自国家气象局。
判断结果基于潮汐运动、潮汐时间、气压趋势、光照和风速构建的模型，仅为规划参考，不保证一定有鱼获，也不用于航行导航。

A personal tarot reading in ChatGPT, with you in the picture. Hunch turns your selfie into tarot art and creates a one-card reading around your question, your relationships or your next chapter.

Your face. Your question. A new way to see yourself.

Meet yourself in the cards

• Love tarot — what do you need to understand about this connection?
• Career tarot — what could help you take your next step?
• Personal growth — what are you ready to leave behind or begin?

• A one-card tarot reading shaped by your question or theme
• Your card’s name, meaning and interpretation in the chat
• An optional handoff to the Hunch chat in WhatsApp, Telegram or iMessage, with a code for the same card

Make it personal
Upload a selfie and share what is on your mind. Hunch asks you to confirm your name, date of birth and artwork preference, using details already available in the conversation when possible. Once your card is ready, the artwork and full reading arrive together in ChatGPT.

Come back with a new question, a new perspective or simply a little curiosity. Ask for your daily tarot card whenever you want a moment to check in with yourself.

For entertainment and self-reflection, not guaranteed predictions or medical, legal or financial advice.
